sp500: Month-end close of the S&P 500 (monthly averages before 1950).
sp500_ret_12m: Price change over the last year.
sp500_ret_6m: Price change over the last 6 months.
drawdown_from_ath: How far below its record high the S&P is.
realized_vol: How much the S&P has actually been swinging (annualized).
cape: Price / 10-year average inflation-adjusted earnings. ~17 is the long-run average.
short_rate: Fed funds rate (T-bill before 1954, commercial paper before 1934).
short_rate_chg_12m: How much short rates moved in the last year. Big positive = Fed hiking.
real_short_rate: Short rate minus inflation. Positive = money is genuinely tight.
t10y: Long-term government borrowing cost (Shiller long rate before 1953).
t10y_chg_12m: How much long rates rose in a year.
curve_10y_3m: Negative = inverted, a classic recession warning.
baa_aaa_spread: Extra yield on riskier corporate bonds. Widening = lenders getting nervous. Back to 1919.
baa: What medium-quality companies pay to borrow.
aaa: What top-quality companies pay to borrow.
hy_spread: Junk-bond premium (FRED only provides the last ~3 years).
lending_standards: Net % of banks tightening business-loan standards (from 1990).
cpi_yoy: Consumer prices vs a year ago.
food_home_yoy: Food-at-home CPI vs a year ago.
gasoline_yoy: Gasoline CPI vs a year ago.
home_price_yoy: Case-Shiller national index vs a year ago (from 1988).
unemployment_chg_12m: Rising unemployment is how recessions show up.
payrolls_yoy: Payroll jobs vs a year ago.
indpro_yoy: Factory/mine/utility output vs a year ago (from 1920).
recession_announced: NBER had declared a recession by this date (real-time announcements began in 1980).
margin_debt: Money investors borrowed against stocks (FINRA, from 1997).
margin_debt_yoy: Margin debt vs a year ago. Fast growth = leveraged speculation (FINRA, from 1998).
bank_failures_12m: FDIC-insured banks failed or assisted in the last 12 months (from 1934).
bank_failed_assets_12m: Total assets of banks that failed in the last 12 months (nominal dollars, from 1934).
dollar_yoy: Trade-weighted dollar vs a year ago (from 1974).
